title: Single-motor robot arm
summary: Six joints driven by one motor. Electromagnetic clutches in the base pick which joint the motor drives, and cables carry the motion up the arm.
points: Two years of research on a novel actuation technique for a six-axis arm.
Built custom solenoids, PCBs, enclosures and actuators.
Designed a universal tool changer for affordable robotics.
Wrote a custom software suite for programming and orchestrating the robot.
Four provisional patents.

title: Baja SAE fuel sensor
summary: Measures fuel level from shifts in the tank's resonant frequency.
points: Designed a sensor suite that tracks resonant frequency deviations from the tank.
Designed a custom PCB and software that isolate the frequencies with fast Fourier transforms.

title: Filament recycler
summary: A low-cost machine that turns failed 3D prints back into usable filament.
points: Uses hall-effect sensor readings to tune the extrusion line as it runs, holding the filament diameter.
Ran tests to check the quality of the plastic it produces.

title: Backyard foundry
summary: A melting furnace built from an empty oil barrel, ceramic wool, refractory cement and a weed burner.
points: Reaches 1200 °C, hot enough to melt aluminium and copper.
Castings made with a custom-built two-part mold, including jewelry and sculptures.

title: Statistical arbitrage model
summary: A statistical arbitrage model running on a compute cluster built from old computers.
points: Developed the model around novel Euclidean-distance algorithms.
Built a homemade 20-node compute cluster with custom network protocols.
Traded live for three months.

title: Hygrade Precision Technologies
role: Engineering intern, then junior engineering technician · Plainville, CT
points: Manufactured parts for SpaceX, Lockheed Martin, Boeing and General Electric.
Metrology for thousands of precision parts with CMMs and height gauges.
Worked through manufacturing issues across the shop's CNC and grinding machines.

title: Olin Baja SAE
summary: Electrical engineering for Olin's Baja SAE car.
points: Designing the fuel-level sensor suite that tracks the tank's resonant frequency.
Custom PCB and FFT software to isolate the frequencies.

title: D.A. Design LLC
summary: A robotics and manufacturing research company that holds Simon's projects and their patents.
points: Founded to eventually commercialize independent projects.
Four provisional patents filed.

title: Dragonfly Engineering
summary: Industrial robotics on a biotech injection-molding line.
points: Reverse engineered six-axis robot arms with proprietary vision systems, bought from Google X.
Programmed industrial robots in KRL for the assembly line.
Converted a three-axis mill into a CNC with a homemade electronics assembly and custom milled brackets.
Designed products for customers with DFM in mind and worked with suppliers to source components.
